name: Wailing Caverns: the Disciple of Naralex does not start Mutanus in Winding Chasm (#8037)
contract: Decision on #8037: the Disciple of Naralex 3678 offers 'Let the event begin!' (gossip menu 201) in Dreamer's
Rock, full runs and Pit of Fangs, but not in a wing whose final boss is not Mutanus 3654. Winding Chasm
(LFGDungeons 1031) ends on Skum 3674, so a Dungeon Finder group assigned it must see no option.

steps.label: SETUP: the hero is in Wailing Caverns
the group is assigned Wailing Caverns - Winding Chasm
the hero opens the Disciple's gossip
DISCRIMINATING: Winding Chasm offers no Mutanus event
